generator: Built-in image_gen; three independent generations using approved concept as style reference

layers.strategy: Overscan plate. x=-camera_x*0.04. At max camera=14000, right extent=1360, leaving 80px beyond 1280 viewport. Do not modulo or stretch to viewport. No far-layer seam enters the level.
layers.packing: Uniform resize to 1920x1080; crop y=250..970 to 1920x720, preserving aspect ratio.

layers.strategy: Generated cutout resized to 1280x720, followed by its horizontal mirror. At x=1280 and x=0/2560 joins, every RGBA edge pixel matches. Draw whole repeat texture every 2560px. Do not crop/reset every 1280px. Mirrored motif is intentional, not hand-painted seamless topology.
layers.packing: Uniform 16:9 resize; horizontal mirror pair; true transparency and structural holes retained.

layers.strategy: Generated low pipe strip cropped to y=496..696, resized to 1280x118 and followed by mirror. Identical-edge joins. Draw AFTER actors but BEFORE HUD. Top is >=622: safely 48px below feet at y574, including faint alpha. Never move upward to fill scene.
layers.packing: Only transparent source padding discarded; uniform scale within <0.2% rounding; alpha preserved.

import_recommendation.repeat: disable texture_repeat when manually drawing repeat copies; alternatively enable repeat and use full repeat dimensions

limitations: Middle and foreground periodicity is made seam-exact using reflection. Reflection is visible if scrutinized; no random unique architecture is claimed.
Far plate coverage is valid for 1280px viewport and max camera=14000 at 0.04 scroll. If level/camera bounds increase, retain overscan or regenerate wider far art.
Generated cutout interiors are mostly alpha 251-253, intentionally preserved. Do not flatten on black.
